raw_segments.text: As before, the attentive ship having disgrayed the whole fight, again came bearing down to
the rescue, and dropping a boat, picked up the floating mariners, tubs, oars, and whatever
else could be caught at, and safely landed them on her decks.
Some sprained shoulders, wrists, and ankles, livid contusions, wrenched harpoons and lances,
inextricable intricacies of rope, shattered oars and planks—all these were there.
But no fatal or even serious ill seemed to have befallen anyone.
As with Fedela the day before, so Ahab was now found grimly clinging to his boat's
